author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones, Stock Market Aided By Apple Stock Earnings | Investor's Business Daily

organizations.name: boeing stock soars among the dow jones

text:
The major stock indexes were broadly higher early Wednesday ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy statement at 2 p.m. ET. The Dow Jones industrials gained more than 200 points in today's stock market . Dow Jones stocks Apple ( AAPL ) and Boeing ( BA ) soared after their earnings results. Meanwhile, top growth stock PayPal ( PYPL ) is set to report its quarterly earnings results after the stock market close.
X
The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite narrowed its early gain to 0.7%. The S&P 500 index gained 0.4%, while the Dow Jones industrials rallied 1.1%. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Stocks: Boeing Stock Soars Among the Dow Jones stocks, Boeing was the top performer with a near-6% gain in Wednesday morning trade. The airplane maker reported better-than-expected Q4 earnings and sales. Boeing stock is breaking out past a handle's 367.42 buy point.
Meanwhile, McDonald's ( MCD ) advanced 2.5% after its U.S. same-store sales missed estimates . McDonald's stock is about 2% away from a cup base's 190.98 buy point, as it tests its 50-day moving average line.
Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Visa ( V ) are still on tap late Wednesday. Microsoft stock and Visa stock are nearing buy points .

Please contact customer service CLOSE Apple Stock Jumps On Earnings After the stock market close Tuesday, Apple stock reported better-than-expected profits . As a result, Apple stock jumped 4% to its highest level since mid-December. Shares are testing their 50-day line, a potential resistance level.
On Jan. 2, Apple warned of weak iPhone sales, particularly in China. Shares plunged 10% on the news, but have been recovering amid the stock market rally.
Stock Market Earnings: AMD Surges, PayPal Due Late Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) surged 12% despite a mixed Q4 earnings report . Earnings matched the Street's target, but came up short on sales. Q1 sales guidance also missed estimates. AMD stock is rising back above its 50-day line after two days of heavy selling sparked by Nvidia's ( NVDA ) revenue warning early Monday.
Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba ( BABA ) gained 4% after its fiscal-Q3 earnings topped forecasts . But revenue fell short of consensus forecasts. Alibaba stock is approaching its long-term 200-day line that is currently priced around 169.50.
After the stock market close Wednesday, PayPal will report its Q4 earnings results. Analysts expect the leading payment processor to earn 67 cents per share on revenue of $4.238 billion. Shares are just below a handle's 92.45 buy point after a breakout last week.
According to the IBD Stock Checkup , PayPal stock boasts a 96 out of a highest-possible 99 IBD Composite Rating. The Composite Rating is a blend of key fundamental and technical metrics designed to gauge a stock's leadership potential.
Additionally, Facebook ( FB ) and Tesla ( TSLA ) also have earnings on deck after the market close . Facebook stock is over 30% off its 52-week high. Tesla stock plunged through its 50- and 200-day lines on Jan. 18 after the company cut profit forecasts.
